reader: manual photo reading, Claude Code session 2026-10-19

wall-01.notes: West end, painted brick, three storeys of shuttered six-over-six windows in five bays; the ground floor has an extra narrow pair near the center (counted as the regular five). No door. Cars block the base.

wall-02.notes: South long side, partly behind a tree and a lamp post: regular shuttered bays with a stair window offset half a storey in the center bay; no door visible in the photographed section.

wall-03.notes: East end, close-up shows only two ground-floor windows over the granite base; assumed to mirror the five-bay west end.

wall-04.notes: North long side: granite-framed entrance with sidelights and transom toward the west end, shuttered windows in a regular rhythm across three storeys.

roof.notes: Dartmouth Row: pitched gable roof, ridge along the long axis.
